capabilities: Compare two notes side by side with line- and word-level highlights
Copy a change or a whole difference from one note to the other
Align matching text with synced scrolling and striped blank space
List differences in a sidebar panel and jump to them
Compare LaTeX files by their section commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states it reads only the two compared notes and makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see or merge the differences between two notes while editing them.

relations.evidence: for example .tex files when a plugin such as Custom File Extensions opens them as text

summary: Side-by-side note comparison that highlights changed lines and words, keeps matching text level, and copies individual changes between notes.
